g.text: kube-vip on cp-1, from ground power to its own
Before init, admin.conf has no rights, so kube-vip borrows super-admin.conf
kubeadm init starts the API server, and kube-vip takes the Lease and the virtual IP
init binds kubeadm:cluster-admins to cluster-admin, so admin.conf now works
One edit points kube-vip at admin.conf, and the ground power is disconnected
cluster-check now fails if any kube-vip still reads super-admin.conf
